recipe_policy: No public231/coherence fitting, tuning, recipe changes or checkpoint selection. Evaluate every declared final profile; no automatic default change or publication.

source.executed_source_status: Record exact bytes and SHA256 for the app, helpers, complete s1 package and this configuration in each stage receipt before inference. Preflight fixes must precede GPU execution; never represent a later checkout as the executed source.

weights.checkpoint_integrity: Snapshot immutable revisions; record tokenizer, processor, configuration and every weight shard identity with hashes; preserve source checkpoints.

runtime.latency_claim: No accepted speedup. Record actual board and environment. Public raw-logit replay durations are CPU replay, never GPU inference latency.

head.sampling: seeded sample without replacement within each batch; batches may revisit training cases
head.initialization: Original selected 52 LM-head token rows and original bias, or zero bias if absent; immutable backbone and native head remain unchanged
head.hidden_features: One native user_question forward per training case; detached FP32 CPU features

attention_lora.selection: Final update 128 only; intermediate adapter snapshots are recovery evidence, never public-selected candidates

training.immutability: Never overwrite published weights; save research decision-head.pt and adapter files separately, recording their hashes. No merged release or automatic publication.

calibration.fit_population: Independent synthetic calibration.jsonl only: 192 cases, 64 per primitive
calibration.objective: mean soft cross entropy against complete known probability targets
calibration.published_global_scope: Common fixed control copied from released checkpoint; it is not claimed to be the Google base's fitted calibration
calibration.replay_policy: Identical recorded raw candidate logits and label identities; no further model call or fitting. Save both reports to expose any uniformizing effect.

synthetic.source: Locally generated finite populations with exact integer enumeration. No corpus download, model-generated answers, public231 or coherence content.
synthetic.holdout: Globally distinct canonical finite worlds, case IDs and request fingerprints across all splits; test template families reserved before generation. Shared primitive logic operations and level sets mean template transfer, not unseen-rule or real-world proof.
synthetic.target_semantics: soft_gold is the known full sampling distribution; hard gold is oracle most-likely only, not the realized outcome of a random draw; exact masses, denominators and expected scores live outside inference requests in provenance.

release_regression.loader: scripts/release_training.py:load_release_data; validates complete release manifest and split/source/request integrity
release_regression.source: Pinned Google Research BoolQ validation, excluding complete training and prior passage source groups; original native MNIST/FSDD test population. Already observed release regressions, not newly unseen after prior validation.
release_regression.fitting_use: none; neither old release train/calibration nor these regressions are continuation fitting or calibration inputs

native_fixture.scope: Text, image, audio and mixed native contract regression; no fitting; separate from all 52 release media cases

public231.fitting_use: none; previously exposed public development screening

coherence.scoring: Pinned official strict overall and outcomes; never substitute graded score or calibration for coherence

statistics.unit: paired source group; never treat repeated slots as independent
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Descriptive predeclared comparisons; no best-of-eight or multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim

evaluation.unsupported_missing_errors_policy: Expose separately; missing, unsupported, unmatched, not-run or insufficient group support is inconclusive, never a pass

requires: Improvement in fresh heldout soft distribution metrics against the declared control, retaining per-type and Score expected-MAE evidence
No demonstrated regression on complete release BoolQ, native52, historic text and native fixture populations
Preserve Score and LOG strengths; inspect calibrated and unit coherence, false accepts and their full denominators
Audit source/model/data/raw responses and pinned official replay; require all declared profile populations complete

formal_noninferiority.status: not_assessed; no arbitrary tolerated-loss margin supplied; without a prospectively defined explicit gate and full support, do not claim noninferiority passed

acceptance.ambiguity: Overlapping intervals, insufficient support, mixed improvements or missing formal gate remain inconclusive. A positive research candidate does not change the SDK default, publish weights or establish deployment readiness.

required_evidence: public raw responses and official summaries for all three temperature policies
head training receipt and decision-head.pt hash
LoRA update log and adapter file hashes
complete failed/not-run status and export log

official.latency_eligibility: unknown; replay latency does not establish GPU latency or published cap eligibility
official.scope: Legacy public231 and strict coherence-mini research only; not the current official public300 plus sealed1200 protocol
